subject: general
question:
The line graph given below shows the total number of different products A, B, C, D and E (in lakh) are imported by a company in 2017 and 2018. Study the graph carefully and answer the following question.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/52eefbda79a15650c6f012a263fb9916cc1bf9418d88e4ba37d2689bf6be7d74.png] 

What was the ratio of the number of type C products imported in the year 2017 to that in 2018?
solution:
**Given:**

Number of different products A, B, C, D and E (in lakh) are imported by a company in 2017 = 20, 25, 20, 30, 20

Number of different products A, B, C, D and E (in lakh) are imported by a company in 2018 = 30, 41.5, 28, 36, 32

**Calculation:**

Type C products imported in the year 2017 = 20

Type C products imported in the year 2018 = 28

Ratio = 20 : 28

⇒ 5 : 7

**∴ Option 2 is the correct answer.**
